title: Cats

source.name: Simple English Wikipedia — Cat
source.note: Chuyển thể sang mức A1 (câu ngắn, từ đơn giản); thông tin theo bài gốc.

paras: Cats are small animals. They are mammals. Many people have a cat at home. A cat at home is called a house cat or a pet. Cats are one of the most popular pets in the world.

People keep cats for two reasons. Cats catch mice and rats. And cats are good friends. People have kept cats for nearly 10,000 years. There are about 92 kinds of cat. Some cats have short hair. Some cats have long hair. Some cats have no hair.
